pullRequests.title: feat(index): Discord alert when publishing fails, and when it works again
pullRequests.author: Lynder063
pullRequests.head: feat/discord-alerts
pullRequests.body:
A failed publish now pings the maintainers' Discord once (with the index-broken issue), and the next good publish closes the issue and says so; without the DISCORD_WEBHOOK_MAINTAINERS secret it stays silent.
Verified: python3 -m unittest discover -s tools/tests passes (alerts mention nobody, only Discord webhook addresses, never fail the job).

pullRequests.title: [WIP] feat(multiplayer): co-op round 3, crossplay, saves, takeover and mod codes
pullRequests.author: Veradictus
pullRequests.head: feat/coop-round3
pullRequests.body:
Round 3 of the RAC1 co-op. Draft: not ready for review or merge.
Adds PAL and NTSC players in one party, co-op saves that never write a player's own story saves, shared progress, every weapon's shots, name tags, late join with Go to host, death rules and optional revive, kick and bans per co-op save, data pack checks, shared camera scripts, enemy grabs, reconnect and host takeover, and mod sync codes.
Reasoning and the settled calls are in multiplayer/DECISIONS.md; behaviour and limits are in…

pullRequests.title: fix(archipelago): reviewable APWorld, logic and client fixes
pullRequests.author: Lynder063
pullRequests.head: fix/archipelago-world
pullRequests.body:
Commit the world's data as data.py and follow AP conventions; fix the .apworld manifest and test it in CI.
Fix logic rows checked against the decomp, and the client: seed check, reconnect, RoomUpdate, compression, location ids.

pullRequests.title: feat(archipelago): remember each save slot's room, with SDK 1.11
pullRequests.author: Lynder063
pullRequests.head: feat/archipelago-save-slot
pullRequests.body:
Pin SDK 1.11.0; the mod keeps which AP room each memory card slot holds and refuses another seed's save.
Checked in the real game with two AP rooms: room A's save accepted, room B gets 0 checks from it.

pullRequests.title: fix(ci): start the index build from the release job
pullRequests.author: Lynder063
pullRequests.head: fix/index-after-release
pullRequests.body:
A release made with the workflow token starts no workflow, so the index never rebuilt after a release.
The release job now starts index.yml itself.

pullRequests.title: List item-randomizer
pullRequests.author: openrac-bot
pullRequests.head: listing/item-randomizer
pullRequests.body:
From #28, checked by the listing bot.
Closes #28

pullRequests.title: fix(bot): unchanged listings, missing repos and unreadable permissions
pullRequests.author: Lynder063
pullRequests.head: fix/bot-submission
pullRequests.body:
An unchanged listing no longer crashes the bot, and a missing repo gets the right message.
When GitHub won't say who can push (403), the check passes and the PR asks a maintainer to confirm.

pullRequests.title: fix(bot): fail when the newest release cannot be listed
pullRequests.author: Lynder063
pullRequests.head: fix/bot-newest-release
pullRequests.body:
The bot passed a repo whose newest release was broken and offered an older one, without saying so.
It now fails and names the skipped release and why; older broken releases stay ignored.

pullRequests.title: feat(index): state AI assistance per mod in the listing
pullRequests.author: Lynder063
pullRequests.head: feat/ai-assisted-listing
pullRequests.body:
Adds an optional aiAssisted listing field, required as a Yes/No answer when submitting a mod.
Marks the 11 current mods once, per listing, so future mods here are not marked automatically.

pullRequests.title: fix(difficulty): leave Blarg Station's own spawns room in the moby pool
pullRequests.author: Lynder063
pullRequests.head: fix/difficulty-blarg-landing
pullRequests.body:
At enemy count 2 the copies filled Blarg Station's pool, so the landing lost the ship and Clank.
The budget now keeps 193 more slots on that level, so its pool of 255 gets no copies.
